description: Archive a feature flag so SDKs stop serving it. Preview returns the flag and any flags that depend on it; apply with confirmed=true after user approval. No restore tool is exposed.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: delete_flag

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. flag contains the flag identity and status; success confirms an applied mutation. dependents lists keys of flags that depend on this flag and serve off once it is archived.

title: Delete flag
